Title: Merged Vampire with title and Anarch status (LSJ)

Messages.Author: Blooded Sand
Messages.Body:
Lucita base goes anarch. She merges.
Is she anarch with a disabled title, or she is the arch bishop of
aragon?

Lucita
Lasombra
Capacity: 8
Group: 2
Advanced, Sabbat: Once each action Lucita performs, she may burn 2
blood to cancel a reaction card played by a vampire with capacity less
than 6 as it is played (no cost is paid).
[MERGED] Archbishop of Aragon.

Lasombra
Capacity: 8
Group: 2
Independent: Sabbat vampires younger than Lucita get -1 intercept when
attempting to block Lucita.

Advanced text has precedence (Rulebook 1.5.6).
She's Sabbat, with the Archbishop of Aragon title.

When the vampire is merged, advanced's cardtext (regarding sect, clan,
title, ...) has precedence. If this makes him/her change clan, then
Clan Impersonation is burned. (Rulebook 1.5.6)

> Does the
> effect from Anarch Convert go away, or is it akin to CI if the vampire
> changes sect?

The Anarch status from Anarch Convert goes away if the Advanced copy
isn't Anarch:
http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/bbfb23fef790e45a

And so would behave the Clan Impersonation card ( = doesn't burn if on
the advanced version, burns if on the base and if the chosen clan
isn't the advanced's clan)

Also, if they do NOT change sect (e.g. The Base Anarch merges to an
Independent Vampire) they should still retain any sect-related
qualities (e.g. Black Hand, Seraph, Anarch, Baron, etc) right?

Messages.Author: floppyzedolfin
Messages.Body:
On 9 juin, 00:23, Juggernaut1981 <brasscompo...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Also, if they do NOT change sect (e.g. The Base Anarch merges to an
> Independent Vampire) they should still retain any sect-related
> qualities (e.g. Black Hand, Seraph, Anarch, Baron, etc) right?

Black Hand and Seraph are not sect-related.
Rulebook 1.5.6 only deals with conflicts of clan / sect / title /
capacity / ..
If both copies have compatible text, then the merged version keeps
those compatible texts (and applies 1.5.6 for incompatibilities)
If base is anarch and advanced is independented, merged would be
anarch indeed.
